Description:

I wasn´t happy enough with vanilla Elliott´s portrait only showing one side of his face, so I decided to make my own Elliott portrait, based on the vanilla version.
I liked it and decided to share with you, if you like it feel free to use it in your game.

[spoiler]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JcAei0Q.jpg?1[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DlXZYLq.jpg?1[/img]
[/spoiler]

Installation::
- Download file
- Extract
- Open your Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits folder
- Back up your Elliott.xnb file that's in your Portraits folder, just in case.
- Copy my Elliott.xnb file over to your Portraits Folder.
- Enjoy[/b]
